title: I’m not sure if this was a normal mall world dream or something else .
content: About a week ago I had a dream I was in a neighborhood I’ve never been in before , living there with my family, (even my dead grandma was still alive ) we were living with another family in the hills of what appeared to be Cali (I’ve lived there before I do not live there now) some paved roads, mostly dirt roads , a lot of white picket fence farm homes / metal farm gates around the homes , everything was normal , we were about to go run errands and all of a sudden evacuation notices were on my phone do to a fire , I thought it was safe to still run errands . I left for maybe 30 minutes and when I came back the neighbor hood was in flames . It felt so real I could feel the heat . Looking at some photos now of the Cali fires some look so much like in my dream…. Does anyone else have dreams like this ? Or other similar events that then happen ?
